_meta.what_this_is: Six agents' autonomy ledgers. Each row is how many of an agent's decisions a human accepted (accepted) out of how many it made (total), plus true_rate -- the acceptance rate it would settle at over thousands of decisions, the label a perfect judge would know. The bar to earn the next autonomy tier is 80%. The fixture pairs short perfect streaks (rate 1.00 but a true rate below the bar) with long strong records, so a rate-only rule promotes the lucky ones.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE. true_rate stands in for the large-sample truth you never actually have; in production you only ever see accepted/total and must decide from the interval. Point the rules at your own accept/reject ledger.
_meta.bar: 0.80 acceptance to earn the next tier
